info.title: AICTE Application Validation Prototype
info.description: Synthetic decision-support demo for SIH 2026 PS 26261. Not an AICTE-integrated service.

post.summary: Upload, persist, and register an application document (S1 Ingest, Guide §4)
post.description: Streams multipart upload, computes BLAKE3 and SHA-256 in one pass, enforces size limits, sniffs magic bytes (PDF, PNG, JPEG), rejects encrypted PDFs, stores in content-addressed vault with deduplication, records blob and upload metadata in a database transaction, and supports idempotent replays via Idempotency-Key header.

get.summary: Retrieve routing and classification result for a persisted document

post.summary: Route and classify a persisted document (S3 Route, Guide §6)
post.description: Inspects extractable text, image coverage, and vector drawings using deterministic thresholds. Routes to Branch A (digital), Branch B (scanned raster), or Mixed. Does not perform forensics (S2), OCR, or document typing.

get.summary: Retrieve raw-byte forensic analysis result for a persisted document

post.summary: Execute raw-byte forensic analysis on a persisted document (S2 Forensics, Guide §5)
post.description: Inspects PDF metadata, incremental updates, digital signatures, image EXIF/geo, and QR locators on immutable original bytes through vault storage. All flags are advisory preliminary indicators.

get.summary: Retrieve S4 Branch B extraction result for a document

post.summary: Execute S4 Branch B extraction pipeline (Guide §7–§9)
post.description: Consumes S3 routes and persisted originals through storage abstraction. Runs raster preprocessing, single composed 3x3 coordinate transform, offline extraction engines, table cell normalisation, arithmetic verification, and produces C1 Unified Document Payload. Processing is cache-aware and idempotent.
